# html-main-content

> Extract the main content of an HTML page as clean text blocks: drop navigation, ads, hidden and boilerplate elements, then pick the article by structure or text density. Python package `trysac-html-main-content`, import name `html_main_content`, MIT licensed, Python >= 3.10, no runtime dependencies.
